_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored) and adjust. Ids below are the live HYMT tracker and place-card image folder.
_higgsfieldUrl_note: /create/image 301s here, and this URL then 307s to ?model=nano-banana-pro. Landing state is therefore always Nano Banana Pro, the one model the router never picks on its own -- every row switches model before generating. generateImage() calls selectOption unconditionally and it throws SelectorNotFoundError when the option is missing, so a failed switch stops the run rather than quietly generating on the wrong model.
